jobs.title: Partner Solution Architect, Partner Center of Excellence
jobs.description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloftâs certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that âEX = CXâ: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

Â 

Agiloft's customers rely on our Ecosystem of System Integration (SI) partners to help them design, build and deliver solutions on the Agiloft platform. This role is designed to help our partners build robust capabilities within their organization and ultimately ensure our customers are realizing maximum value from the platform.

As Partner Solution Architect, you'll support the partners as a technical advisor for partner-led implementations from kickoff through go-live. You'll guide SIs on architecture, integrations, data sync, and configuration. When something breaks, you'll figure out whether it's a configuration issue, an integration issue, or a real product defect, and get it to the right owner.

You'll sit in the Partner Center of Excellence, the team responsible for making partner delivery repeatable and high quality. Our Partner Alliance Managers own the overall relationship with each partner and this role will be responsible for the successful technical outcome and capability development. You'll work daily with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll turn what you learn on each project into playbooks the whole ecosystem can use.

Â 

Job Responsibilities

What you'll do

Guide Partners to Go-live

Serve as the product & technical point of contact for SI partners and their customers during the implementation project and through go-live. Advise on solution architecture, integration design, data synchronization, and configuration best practices across Agiloft's platform: core CLM, procurement and source-to-pay workflows, ERP sync (such as SAP S/4HANA), APIs and MCP-based orchestration, and AI and analytics capabilities. Help partners separate out-of-the-box capability from custom implementation work so each fix lands with the right owner.

Own the Technical Escalation Path

Act as the Tier 3 technical resource for partner-led projects. Triage and reproduce issues, document them clearly, and log true defects and enhancement requests to Product and Engineering in Jira. Join partner and customer working sessions when a blocker needs Agiloft in the room. Hand accounts off cleanly to Support at transition, with documented configuration and open items.

Enable the Ecosystem

Build and deliver partner training, webinars, and learning content with Product and go-to-market teams. Work with Product and Engineering to stand up and maintain partner sandboxes, test environments, and knowledge base access. Support the change management and promote the value of monthly releases into the partner ecosystem.

Build the Playbook

Create and maintain implementation playbooks, a known-issue library, escalation runbooks, and environment setup guides. Feed patterns from real projects back into enablement, documentation, and the product roadmap.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

Partner-led go-lives land on schedule, with fewer slipping because of unresolved technical blockers. Technical escalations from partners reach a clear owner quickly, with reproducible detail, and resolve faster. Product and Engineering receive structured, prioritized signal from partner projects instead of ad hoc pulls. Product and Engineering receive a steady, well-documented stream of implementation feedback that shapes the roadmap. A working go-live toolkit exists and partners actually use it: playbooks, known-issue library, runbooks, reference architectures, and environment guides. Support inherits cleaner, better-documented accounts at handoff. Target metrics: e.g. on-time go-live rate, median time to resolve partner escalations, escalations per quarter, training events delivered. Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

What you'll bring

5+ years in a technical, customer- or partner-facing implementation role: solution architecture, professional services, implementation or integration consulting, or sales engineering with post-sale delivery. Agiloft certification, or relevant platform certifications (Salesforce, SAP, cloud). Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT), and data sync between systems of record. Working knowledge of the systems CLM connects to, such as Salesforce, ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), and Procurement relevant ISVs Strong troubleshooting instincts. You can isolate whether an issue is configuration, integration, or product defect, and explain it precisely to engineers and executives alike. Solution design skills: you can translate business requirements into a technical design and explain the trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders. Experience guiding external partners or customers while working across Product, Engineering, and Support. Exposure to AI-enabled workflows, LLM tooling, or MCP-based integrations. A builder's habit of turning one-off fixes into reusable documentation and process.

Preferred Qualifications

Nice to have

Integration middleware experience: Workato, MuleSoft, or Boomi. Background in CLM, procurement or source-to-pay, CPQ, or related enterprise workflow platforms; hands-on experience implementing a CLM platform is a strong plus. Prior work at or alongside SI and consulting partners. Exposure to ISV/managed-package delivery, versioning, and enterprise deployment considerations. Prior experience working directly with or inside SI or consulting partners.

jobs.description:
Your mission

About GENUINE

GENUINE is Europe’s leading TikTok Shop agency, and we’re right in the middle of the social commerce revolution. We don’t just make content. We build shopping experiences that sell, at the speed of a viral trend. We’re growing fast, and so does our Finance & Operations team.

The Mission

Behind every viral LIVE and every creator campaign, a lot of money moves: platform fees, creator commissions, client payouts. You’ll help keep all of it clean, on time and under control. You’ll see how a hypergrowth agency really runs, and you’ll learn more in a few months than in most full-time jobs.

What You’ll Do

  • Follow the money: Own the monthly reconciliation of TikTok Shop settlements, fees and affiliate commissions against our records, and close every gap.
  • Turn data into insights: Build and own the reports that show which clients, creators and LIVE sessions actually make money.
  • Run creator payouts: Manage the payout process end to end, from checking invoices to making sure everyone gets paid correctly and on time.
  • Keep the books tidy: Prepare the monthly close with accounting and our tax advisor, so everything is complete and on time.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Drive the setup of tools that connect TikTok Shop data with our accounting software, and improve our processes as we scale.
  • Have a say in strategy: Run analyses for pricing, client offers and leadership decisions, and present your findings to management.

Your profile

Who You Are

  • Background: You’ve finished a degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Business Informatics or something similar.

Strategy & Operations (3-6 YoE)

London, 5x days per week in-office

 

Vega is looking for multi-disciplinary A players who have what it takes to build a business from the ground up. We hire people who are already high-performers in MBB or finance/investing, but still have the itch to do more. This role will sit in the CEO Office, reporting to the Head of Strategy & Growth, working across the highest strategic priorities in the business.

 

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

 

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

 

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

 

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

 

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Context-switch across strategy, go-to-market, operations, client delivery, external comms, special projects, and investor relations

  • Take on client-facing engagement responsibilities as needed, owning the day-to-day relationship and delivery coordination for enterprise customers.

  • Be able to own projects from Day 1, including representing Vega externally

  • Sit in the CEO Office, reporting directly to the Head of Strategy & Growth

  • Work closely with the Product & Growth and Engineering teams - strategy is not a silo at Vega

 

What we look for:

  • Required: 3-6 years of experience in MBB or finance/investing at a Tier 1 institution, with a clear spike in strategic thinking.

  • Whilst stellar training is essential, this is not all that we look for and not everyone with a background in MBB/investing will do well. This role is for people who have high standards of excellence for themselves, along with the risk tolerance and ambition to go beyond the comfort zone and structure of a larger institution.

  • Low ego, and a willingness to get stuck in; this role will allow you to do career-accelerating things that you might otherwise wait decades to do - but there will also be gruntwork. Everyone at Vega, including leadership, handles both.

  • Exceptional analytical and communication skills. You will need to think and explain complex concepts and communicate them to a range of stakeholders (e.g., enterprise customers, business, tech, and ops teams) with different audiences.

  • Confidence and judgement, with the ability to decide when and how to challenge requests, and an awareness of scalability and trade-offs when making those judgement calls.

 

Why join us?

  • Get a first-hand view, and real ownership of, everything that it takes to operate a fast-growing business

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business.   • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling.

  • First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations.

  • Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers.

  • Excellent written communication, since the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate analysis and reporting, or a clear appetite to build that skill quickly.

Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations

We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10.

About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.

Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care.

Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in.

What you'll do

You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team.

1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness

Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use.

  • Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement.

  • Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text).

  • Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable.

  • Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input.

  • Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions.

2. Clinical knowledge base

Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records.

  • Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships.

  • Clinical terminologies: ingest and map TC3, SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and related NHS standards, including cross-mappings between them.

  • Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts.

  • Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database.

  • Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows.

By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product.

What we're looking for

We don't expect one person to be expert in everything below. Strong candidates will be deep in one workstream and credible in the other.

Must-haves

  • Strong Python and data engineering skills, with a track record of shipping production data or ML pipelines, not just research notebooks.

  • Hands-on experience building ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or test harnesses, ideally for vision, video or language models.

  • Experience running data labelling and training-data preparation, including annotation tooling and quality control.

  • Working knowledge of databases and data modelling.

  • Practical NLP experience: entity extraction, entity linking or document parsing.

  • Comfort handling sensitive data under data protection and clinical safety constraints.

  • Pragmatism and speed: you can work with ambiguity, make good build-vs-buy calls and ship in weeks, not quarters.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SNOMED CT, ICD-10, dm+d or other NHS clinical terminologies and coding.

  • A background in health-tech, clinical informatics or another regulated domain such as defence.

  • Experience with video data at scale (frame sampling, temporal annotation, multimodal datasets).

  • Familiarity with FHIR or HL7 interoperability standards.

  • Experience working with LLMs and VLMs, including edge or on-device deployment.

  • Early-stage startup experience, especially as a founding or early engineer.

Probably not the right fit if

  • You need detailed specs and a large team around you to be effective.

  • You prefer pure research over building tools people use every day.

This is a high urgency opening, and we are flexible to consider applicants either on a more flexible consultancy agreement (rolling by mutual agreement, with a competitive day rate); or a long term permanent employment contract with shares as part of the package and scope to grow into a longer-term role as Tricorder builds its engineering team.

À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

En tant que Data Migration Project Manager, tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.

À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client, ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %), tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z

  • Piloter le suivi et l’avancement des projets à travers des meetings clients

  • Comprendre les enjeux métier et Privacy du client afin d’adapter la stratégie de migration à son contexte et à ses besoins.

  • Accompagner le client dans les choix techniques et data nécessaires à sa migration

  • Sécuriser chaque étape de la migration, de la préparation des données jusqu’à leur intégration dans Dastra

  • Analyser et structurer les données sources du client

  • Construire le mapping entre les données clients et le modèle de données Dastra

  • Définir et paramétrer les règles de transformation nécessaires à la migration

  • Contrôler les données tout au long du processus de migration

  • Comprendre la logique des scripts et des flux de données

Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisées via des scripts spécifiques : nous ne cherchons donc pas un développeur, mais quelqu'un qui comprend suffisamment la technique pour prendre les bonnes décisions.

Ce qui fera la différence

Tu es curieux·se, autonome et débrouillard·e : face à un nouvel outil ou une problématique que tu ne connais pas, tu cherches, tu comprends et tu proposes.

Tu apprécies autant comprendre comment fonctionne une plateforme que piloter un projet et accompagner un client jusqu'à sa réussite.
